enhancements.name: source graph lineage check
enhancements.improves: source graph use and claim lineage
enhancements.method: Every strategic claim must preserve source -> receipt -> claim -> cluster -> route implication lineage.
enhancements.testable_rule: claims without source_receipt lineage remain internal hypothesis only

enhancements.name: evidence burden lane
enhancements.method: Route implications must carry missing evidence and cheapest next evidence.
enhancements.testable_rule: route pressure cannot advance without burden state

enhancements.name: high-imagination preservation lane
enhancements.method: Low evidence cannot delete a high-imagination thread; it can only park or require simulation/public evidence.
enhancements.testable_rule: parked high-imagination clusters retain explicit resume instruction
